subject: Peregrine site tour - travel overlap and demo plan
messages:
From: Lauren Shaw <lauren@peregrinetx.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tara Mendes <tara.mendes@peregrinetx.com>, itinerary@peregrinetx.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite tour + product demo (July 28) — travel conflict

Hi Marcus,

Quick heads up — our head of R&D (staying on a separate site visit) is going to be delayed returning until the evening of Jul 28. That means the originally planned in-person window for Jul 28 morning won't include one of the tech decision-makers.

We still want to see Redwood's end-to-end demo and meet the team. Two options from our side: 1) move the main demo to Jul 29 (same on-site schedule) or 2) keep Jul 28 but record the walkthrough and run a live Q&A with your engineers via call later that afternoon when the exec is available.

I attached the travel calendar we've been sharing internally (Peregrine_Travel_Window.ics) so you can see the constraints. Can you let me know what would be easiest for your team? We have flexibility on Jul 29 but a few constraints around lab visits.

Thanks — Lauren
Laurent Shaw | Director, Product Strategy
Peregrine Therapeutics

--
Attachment: Peregrine_Travel_Window.ics (calendar stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Shaw <lauren@peregrinetx.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite tour + product demo (July 28) — travel conflict

Hi Lauren — really appreciate the heads up and the calendar.

We can do either, but to keep to your lab visit constraints I propose this hybrid plan to avoid a full rebook:

- Keep Jul 28 morning as the onsite tour for the local stakeholders (we'll run the condensed walkthrough).
- We will record the full product demo (30–40m) with screen + audio and share the recording by EOD Jul 28.
- Live Q&A with your delayed executive at 3:30pm PT on Jul 28 (we'll set aside 45m). Grace will lead the live session and Karthik will be on the call for architecture/ops questions.

If that works, we'll: update the agenda (attached as redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf), adjust the calendar invite, and place a clear note in the recording on timestamps for the architecture deep-dive so execs can skip ahead. If you prefer Jul 29 instead, we can move the full demo but that will push follow-ups and our engineers' travel plans.

Proposed calendar actions if you confirm the hybrid plan:
- I will keep the Jul 28 invite as-is but add a separate "Live Q&A (remote)" slot at 15:30 PT.
- Publish the recording and a one-page TL;DR with callouts.

LMK which you prefer and I'll action today.

Cheers,
Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199
--
Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda), recording-setup-checklist.txt (internal checklist)

Nice — happy to take the live Q&A. Quick notes: 

- I'll arrive onsite at 08:30 to run the condensed walkthrough and ensure the recording setup (AV + screen capture) is tested by 09:15.
- Karthik — please confirm you'll be available at 15:30 PT for the architecture portion. If you need a prep call, let's do 14:00 PT.
- I will seed a timestamped index in the recording (Architecture section starts ~19:00) so the exec can jump directly to it.

We should also include a short preface in the recording that calls out data handling and security notes (SOC/SLA highlights) — I can record that intro.

On logistics: Marcus, if you add the "Live Q&A" calendar slot and share the recording link once uploaded, I will manage the chat and follow-up Jira tickets during the Q&A.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Kept Jul 28 onsite walkthrough for on-site attendees (08:30–11:30).
- Added "Live Q&A (remote)" at 15:30–16:15 PT on Jul 28 for your delayed exec.
- Uploaded the recorded demo to a shared Drive folder and added a timestamped index. Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/EXAMPLE_DEMO_LINK
- Attached the updated agenda to the calendar invite; the invite now includes Grace as presenter and Karthik as technical lead.

Next steps for your side: confirm the 15:30 PT remote slot is acceptable for the exec and whether they prefer dial-in (we'll provide a Zoom link) or a conference room bridge.

If everything is good, I'll lock the invite and send a short pre-demo checklist to your itinerary team.

Best,
Marcus
